# Adit Hardiansyah Surachman (Portfolio)

> Software Engineer & Network Security Specialist based in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. Computer Science graduate from STMIK Mardira Indonesia (GPA 3.62/4.00, Sangat Memuaskan) with verified Google Cybersecurity and national BNSP certifications.

## Featured Production Projects

- [GadgetVault](https://gadget-vault-seven.vercel.app/): Premium e-commerce marketplace for flagship gadgets built with Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
- [Surabi Cikal Cisangkan](https://surabi-cikal-cisangkan.vercel.app/): Digital storefront and catalog for an authentic culinary business built with React and Vite.
- [Sistem Kas Masjid AT-Tijaniyah](https://github.com/Wilhelm-art/kas-masjid-tijaniyah): Public financial ledger and prayer schedule widget built with Laravel 10 and MySQL.
- [SaveTok](https://savetok-frontend.vercel.app/): High-performance, no-watermark video utility built with React, Vite, and Express.js.
- [Komik Zynqtoon](https://zynqtoon.vercel.app/): Comic and webtoon reading platform with smooth reader mode built with Next.js.
